snapshot.title: SSC English: Sentence Correction & Spotting Errors
snapshot.exam_hook: ⚡ SSC Speed Hook: No sooner...THAN. Hardly...WHEN. No "return back". No "not" with Unless/Until. Parallel structure. Only placement.

quick_notes.title: Conjunction Pairs (Correlatives)
quick_notes.detail: 1. Neither... nor. 2. Either... or. 3. Not only... but also. 4. Hardley/Scarcely... WHEN (not than). 5. No sooner... THAN (not when/then). 6. Although... YET (or a comma).

quick_notes.title: Redundancy (Superfluous) Errors
quick_notes.detail: Words with same meaning used together. 1. Return back (Incorrect). 2. Revert back (Incorrect). 3. Cousin brother/sister (Incorrect - just use "Cousin"). 4. Repeat again (Incorrect).

quick_notes.title: Rule of Parallelism
quick_notes.detail: Items in a list must have the same grammatical form. (Correct: I like swimming, dancing, and singing. Incorrect : I like swimming, to dance, and singing).

quick_notes.title: Placement of "Only"
quick_notes.detail: "Only" should be placed immediately before the word it modifies. (Correct: I solved only two questions. Incorrect : I only solved two questions).

quick_notes.title: Unless vs Until
quick_notes.detail: UNLESS: Refers to condition (if not). UNTIL : Refers to time (up to). Trap : Never use "not" in the clause starting with Unless/Until.

topic_title: SSC English: Sentence Correction & Spotting Errors
lesson_intro: Today we enter the 'Audit Phase'. Sentence Correction and Spotting Errors are where all your grammar rules come together. In SSC, these questions are designed to trick you with 'Parallelism', 'Redundancy', and 'Wrong Word usage'. Do you say 'Return back'? (No, 'Return' is enough!). Do you know that 'Scarcely' is followed by 'When' and not 'Than'? Toppers use the 'Checklist Method' to scan for errors. Let's practice the art of error detection today.
